clips.text: Hi, I’m Sahnawaz — a full-stack developer and UI designer from Assam. Everything on this site is hand-coded, with no templates. Let me show you around in about a minute.
These are my live products: YojanaSahay, a free government-scheme finder used across India, StudyLens AI for students, and this website. Open any case study and you can ask it questions.
Hiring? Paste your job post here. An AI compares it with my real work and tells you honestly where I match, and where I don’t.
This is how I ship. Every change goes through GitHub, is built automatically, and goes live in about a minute, with one-click rollback.
And this is live telemetry, pulled straight from GitHub: what I shipped recently, my commit streak, and how healthy my projects are.
Ready to talk? Message me, WhatsApp me, or request a call. I personally read every message. Thanks for taking the tour!
